food._source: consumptionPerHour 104 kcal/h ≈ 2500 kcal/day, within the CSA crew-diet range 1900–3200 kcal/day (src/data/real/csa_food.json). Crop times are time-compressed but keep the real order (CSA days; quinoa from NASA TP-3422). kcal grow with the wait. Moisture: a tray holds trayCapacityL litres at moisture 1; it grows only inside [dryAt, floodAt] (wide band: forgiving for young players). Spirulina (bioreactor) grows only under light (growthHours = lit hours).

nutrients._source: Recirculating hydroponics (NFT): plants take mineral nutrients (N, P, K…) from the solution, so it must be topped up. Game-balance values: 4 lit trays use ≈0.26/day; a depleted solution halves growth and never kills.

photosynthesis._source: Photosynthesis under the grow lights: each healthy tray removes a little CO₂ (ppm/h) and releases a little O₂ (%/h). Order of magnitude only, game-balance values.

cold._source: Most leafy crops grow best at 18–24 °C and slow down below that. Game-balance values: under belowC growth is multiplied by growthFactor; cold never kills. Makes a low thermostat a real trade-off.

kitchen._source: Harvests become raw pantry lots that spoil after rawShelfHours. Processing (dehydrating + pressing into bars, as in long-duration space food) preserves and concentrates them: kcal × multiplier, costing hydro-circuit power and time. Eating raw gives 100 % kcal. Game-balance values, not measured data.
